supersession_reason: Granular re-entry showed F2-WP-605 generation 1 was already ACCEPTED_AT_SCOPE despite stale aggregate STATE. G1 already provides deterministic whole-child telemetry with cpu_time_ns, peak_rss_bytes, tokens, tool_calls/work_units, canonical serialization and exact ChildReconcileEvidence binding. The nonredundant research delta is therefore narrowed to optional per-tool/effect resource sub-observations, not a new WP605 baseline implementation.
problem_or_gap: WP605 G1 binds one aggregate child telemetry sample to an exact ChildReconcileEvidence and already canonicalizes explicit whole-child counters. It does not preserve a sequence of per-tool/effect resource measurements. The E4 collision fixture shows two children can share the same aggregate resource summary while differing in whether the failed tool was the high-resource tool.

proposed_delta.summary: Only if Trigger4 confirms nonredundant value, add a generation-2 compatible per-tool/effect ResourceSubObservation structure subordinate to ChildTelemetrySample or referenced as opaque typed measurement evidence. Do not replace G1 whole-child counters and do not create a second telemetry authority.
minimum_identity: causal identity/digest inherited from existing child binding
minimum_measurement_semantics: peak/current resource fields when actually observed
termination cause epistemic state with evidence refs
hard_rules: parent endpoint RSS cannot be labeled child/tool peak
resource hints are candidate-only and cannot self-grant budget/capability
missing observer coverage is explicit UNKNOWN/DEGRADED
G1 ChildReconcileEvidence and telemetry identity remain authoritative for the whole-child sample

counterhypotheses: Whole-child G1 telemetry plus existing tool result/effect evidence is already sufficient; per-tool resource sub-observations are unnecessary complexity.
Per-tool resource measurements cannot be collected accurately/cheaply enough to justify persistent schema surface.
A separate external analysis artifact linked through provenance_refs is better than extending the G1 dataclass/schema.
baseline_definition: Canonical WP605 G1 at merge 8443f2fb8391e40007a6ea9fd97bfe25ac65b3a5: one immutable whole-child ChildTelemetrySample bound to exact ChildReconcileEvidence with duration, cpu_time_ns, peak_rss_bytes, token counts, tool_calls, work_units, opaque quality/provenance refs and canonical content-bound identity.
required_tests: prove a G2/sub-observation adds a causal distinction that G1 plus existing effect/tool evidence cannot already recover
preserve exact G1 roundtrip/consumer verification and fail-closed behavior
reject post-hoc tool identity relabeling and wrong generation/provenance
deliberate non-OOM SIGKILL must remain OOM UNKNOWN unless corroborated
observer failure must become explicit UNKNOWN/DEGRADED coverage
metric semantics prohibit parent endpoint RSS => child/tool peak promotion
canonical serialization handles quotes/backslashes/newlines/control-sensitive values via typed validation
no resource hint can mutate canonical budget/capability authority
required_ablations: WP605 G1 only versus G1 plus proposed per-tool resource sub-observations on the E4 collision fixture
G1 plus already-existing effect/tool evidence versus explicit resource sub-observations to test whether the new structure is redundant
required_measurements: collector coverage/accuracy on separately admitted runtime evidence
quality_success_metric: Only promote if per-tool sub-observations add reproducible nonredundant causal localization beyond G1/existing effect evidence while preserving exact G1 authority and bounded overhead.
rollback_or_reject_rule: Reject candidate entirely if current G1 plus existing tool/effect evidence can answer the E4 causal question without new persistent structure, or if accurate per-tool measurement requires disproportionate complexity. Preserve the donor falsifiers as test guidance even when candidate is rejected.
known_failure_modes: stale aggregate STATE causing duplicate work
upstream performance claims promoted without F2 evidence
trigger4_reentry_instruction: Do not reopen or duplicate accepted WP605 G1. First prove that the proposed G2/sub-observation structure is nonredundant against current G1 plus existing effect/tool evidence; otherwise reject/close this candidate with the E3 donor falsifiers retained as negative test knowledge.
